children: Tesla AI chief Ashok Elluswamy said on X that the company’s Robotaxi service is not far from achieving 24-hour operation. According to Sina Finance, he said the round-the-clock service would go live “around next month” after the next technology in the v15 plan is integrated.
Tesla’s Robotaxi service currently operates seven days a week in the United States from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m., covering Austin, Dallas, Houston, Miami, Orlando, and Tampa.

title: Tesla Robotaxi May Reach 24-Hour Operation Next Month, AI Chief Says
